definitions.gloss: armor and helmet; suit of armor
definitions.explanation: A complete set of Japanese warrior armor, including both the body armor ({甲|かぶと}) and helmet ({冑|かぶと}). Refers to the traditional armor worn by samurai and displayed as cultural artifacts in museums and during festivals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{甲冑|かっちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A suit of armor is on display at the museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甲冑|かっちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まとって⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The warrior donned his armor and headed to the battlefield.

examples.japanese: ⟦{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}→端午の節句：16518_tangonosekku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甲冑|かっちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some families display a suit of armor for Boys' Day.

notes:
USAGE: {甲冑|かっちゅう} specifically refers to Japanese armor as a combined set of body protection ({甲|かぶと} or ⟦{鎧|よろい}→鎧：14541_yoroi⟧) and helmet ({冑|かぶと}). It is commonly encountered in historical contexts, museum descriptions, and discussions of Japanese warrior culture.

During ⟦{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}→端午の節句：16518_tangonosekku⟧ (Boys' Day, May 5th), miniature {甲冑|かっちゅう} are displayed in homes to wish boys health and strength.
